scope: Canonical post-H0.0 planning state. Reconstruct H0.1 from Git, confirm the fresh canonical main after checkpoint integration, and prepare a separate bounded C22 child Work Order/branch. This Work Order itself must not change runtime or create the C22 branch before Director dispatch.
required_outputs: Director-dispatched child C22 Work Order on then-current main
Fresh current-main C22 branch only after dispatch
stop_conditions: H0.0 checkpoint has not been canonically integrated
Canonical main movement has not been audited
Any runtime/domain change is attempted under this planning Work Order
C22 branch creation is attempted before Director dispatch
PC0 has an unresolved blocking RED
Any canonical architecture/ownership change becomes necessary
risk_reasons: H0.1 is the first controlled runtime-development pilot and will later create a C22 runtime child Work Order.
Incorrect handoff could authorize runtime from stale main or bypass H0.0 evidence.
Recovery and exact-head evidence are checkpoint-critical.

design_brief.problem_statement: H0.0 R3 reached CHECKPOINT_PROPOSED, but canonical main advanced to registry generation 69. The verified R3 execution must become historical evidence while canonical CONTROL_DEVELOPMENT moves to a fresh generation-69 planning state instead of continuing a generation-67 terminal epoch.
design_brief.current_behavior: The verified H0.0 launcher points to E2026-08-11-H0-0-R3. A naive merge onto generation 69 would make strict registry identity fail closed and leave no canonical next-phase state.
design_brief.desired_behavior: After H0.0 integration, canonical Status/Plan/Resume select a fresh generation-69 H0.1 planning epoch, report H0.1 as the next checkpoint, keep runtime workers at zero until Director dispatch, and preserve R3 as immutable historical evidence.
alternatives_considered: Rewrite the R3 epoch registry generation in place.
Leave the canonical launcher pointing at terminal R3 and repair it later.
Create a fresh H0.1 planning epoch and keep R3 historical.
design_brief.selected_design: Create E2026-08-11-H0-1-R1 on exact generation-69 main, switch only the canonical launcher/planner to it, preserve strict epoch identity, and forbid runtime/branch creation until a separate Director dispatch creates the bounded C22 child Work Order.
design_brief.why_selected: This preserves fail-closed epoch identity, gives main a restart-safe next state immediately after H0.0, and does not pre-authorize C22 runtime.
non_goals: No C22 runtime implementation in the canonicalization change
No weakening of epoch or registry validation
expected_risks: Planner accidentally authorizes a runtime worker while the dispatch Work Order is only PLANNED
Historical R3 evidence accidentally becomes active again
Main moves again before canonical checkpoint integration
validation_plan: Validate H0.1 epoch/work-order/event schemas against canonical contracts.
Require launcher to select only E2026-08-11-H0-1-R1.
Require Plan on the planning state to report H0.1 and zero autonomous runtime workers.
Require Status/Resume to reconstruct the fresh epoch from Git only.
Run focused harness tests and standard/directional PC0 NON_RED.
After actual canonical merge, perform a post-merge main-movement audit before Director dispatch.

notes: This is a canonical planning coordinator, not the C22 implementation Work Order. Runtime branch creation remains forbidden until H0.0 is canonical and a Director dispatch creates the child C22 Work Order.
